prompt: Use case: logo-brand. Create ONE new variation of the supplied logo reference, not a collage. App: Edit Echidna. Original direction 1: Small steps studio. Original palette and identity: Warm paper #F4E9D2, teal #2D5658, ochre #D1A950. Gentle echidna line mascot, spacious writing desk and friendly serif headings.. Variation C: One useful change. Reference role: original logo, preserve its central concept and recognisable family resemblance while making a visibly distinct candidate. Original emblem: A simple echidna silhouette whose three quills are short pencil strokes, with a tiny rounded snout.. Specific new construction: A bold long-snouted echidna silhouette with three pencil strokes in negative space.. Treatment: Rebuild the defining emblem into a bold compact symbol using clever interlocking forms or negative space. Strong recognisable silhouette with two or three flat colours. Use a distinctive bold wordmark. No enclosing generic app-icon square. Exact wordmark text: 'Edit Echidna'. Keep the same spelling and original palette. Compose one emblem plus one wordmark together, centred with generous margins on a square canvas. Transparent background with real alpha; no white or coloured background. Flat, professional, memorable and readable at small sizes; no mockup, no presentation board, no lettering other than the app name, no variant labels, no tagline, no shadows, no gradients. Do not simply copy the original unchanged.
